description:
Yeon Dana possessed the body of “Danae Windsor.” The only way back to her original world was through the Dimensional Gate.

But when her loved ones tearfully begged her to stay, she gave up on returning. She turned her back on the gate that only opens once every 100 years.

Three years later. Everyone who had desperately clung to Dana suddenly showed their true colors.

“I have no intention of breaking off our engagement. However, I do intend to marry her as well.” Her fiancé, openly and shamelessly committing infidelity;

“I just held you back as a joke, you know? I didn't think you'd actually give up on going back.” Her younger brother, who only now confessed that his desperate pleas were a mere prank;

“It’s not like anyone tied you up and forced you to stay, did they?” And even her older cousin, who callously mocked her.

“The Dimensional Gate is closed. You can't leave anymore, Dana! So just be a good girl and adapt to this world!”

But Dana knows something they don’t. She knows exactly how to end this possession and return home. Her sorrow over being betrayed by the people she loved was fleeting; fueled by burning rage, Dana prepares her revenge and her ultimate escape.

‘So these bastards played me for a fool.’

Honestly. I really just wanted to live a good, quiet life this time around.

‘You messed with the wrong person.’

She decides to return to her original world. Right at the exact moment they firmly believe she will stay by their side forever
